acceptance: A parked agy submission is detected and re-sent (fake pane, red first)

consumed.resolution: agy-tmux declares the > input-line marker (go/internal/bridge/driver_agytmux.go, agyTmuxLaunch). agy 1.2.17 parks an unsubmitted paste as '> [Pasted text #N +M lines]' on that line, so submit-verify detects it and re-sends Enter. Pinned against real 1.2.17 panes (go/internal/bridge/panestream/testdata/agy-1.2.17) by TestAgyTmux_ParkedPasteChipIsResubmitted, TestAgyTmux_ParkedTypedNudgeIsResubmitted, TestAgyTmux_SubmittedPanesAreVerifiedWithoutResend and TestRealDriversDeclareInputLineMarker (agy delisted from noInputLine). Design: docs/research/agy-liveness-monitoring-2026-10.md, A2.

fix: Capture agy's input line live (agy 1.2.16+), declare its marker in the agy-tmux manifest/driver the way claude and codex do, and pin it with the input-line marker test that covers the real drivers.
source: console, 2026-10-05, evolve doctor live agy-tmux and the agy fallback review
summary: agy-tmux declares no input-line marker (driver_agytmux.go), so submit-verify cannot tell a parked prompt from a submitted one ('submit-verify: prompt NOT verified — agy-tmux declares no input-line marker'). A stalled submission costs the whole artifact window. Since 2026-10-05 agy is in the last-resort tail of about 80 phases, and router runs on agy every cycle.
title: agy-tmux declares an input-line marker so a stalled submission is detected and re-sent
